synth.name: Tuning Divisions Per Period
synth.description: Equal divisions of the period (12 = standard 12-TET, 19/22/31/53 etc. for microtonal EDOs). Ignored while a custom scale table is loaded.

synth.name: Tuning Period
synth.description: Size of the repeating period. 1200 = octave, 1901.955 = tritave (Bohlen-Pierce).

synth.name: Tuning Reference Note
synth.description: MIDI note number that sounds at the reference frequency.

synth.name: Tuning Reference Frequency
synth.description: Frequency of the reference note.

synth.name: Osc1 Waveform
synth.description: Waveform of oscillator 1. Wavetable plays the bank chosen in Osc1 Wavetable at Osc1 WT Position.

synth.name: Osc1 Pulse Width
synth.description: Duty cycle of oscillator 1 when its waveform is Pulse (0.5 = square).

synth.name: Osc1 Level
synth.description: Mix level of oscillator 1.

synth.name: Osc2 Waveform
synth.description: Waveform of oscillator 2. Wavetable plays the bank chosen in Osc2 Wavetable at Osc2 WT Position.

synth.name: Osc2 Pulse Width
synth.description: Duty cycle of oscillator 2 when its waveform is Pulse (0.5 = square).

synth.name: Osc2 Level
synth.description: Mix level of oscillator 2.

synth.name: Osc2 Transpose
synth.description: Coarse pitch offset of oscillator 2 in cents (tuning independent; 1200 = one octave up).

synth.name: Osc2 Detune
synth.description: Fine detune of oscillator 2 against oscillator 1.

synth.name: Sub Osc Level
synth.description: Square wave one octave below oscillator 1.

synth.name: Noise Level
synth.description: White noise mixed into the filter input.

synth.name: Osc2 Hard Sync
synth.description: Restart oscillator 2 every cycle of oscillator 1 (classic sync lead; sweep Osc2 Transpose or Osc2 Env Pitch).

synth.name: Osc2 Env Pitch
synth.description: How far the filter envelope bends oscillator 2 pitch (sync sweeps, FM brightness changes).

synth.name: FM Index
synth.description: Phase modulation of oscillator 1 by oscillator 2 (0 = off; use Sine waves for bells/e-pianos).

synth.name: Filter Mode
synth.description: Filter response type.

synth.name: Filter Cutoff
synth.description: Base cutoff frequency of the resonant filter.

synth.name: Filter Resonance
synth.description: Filter resonance (approaches self-oscillation near 1).

synth.name: Filter Slope
synth.description: Filter slope: 2-pole or 4-pole.

synth.name: Filter Drive
synth.description: Soft saturation before the filter.

synth.name: Filter Env Amount
synth.description: How far the filter envelope moves the cutoff, in octaves.

synth.name: Filter Key Tracking
synth.description: Cutoff follows note frequency (1 = fully).

synth.name: Filter Velocity Amount
synth.description: How much note velocity scales the filter envelope.

synth.name: Filter Env Attack
synth.description: Filter envelope attack time.

synth.name: Filter Env Decay
synth.description: Filter envelope decay time.

synth.name: Filter Env Sustain
synth.description: Filter envelope sustain level.

synth.name: Filter Env Release
synth.description: Filter envelope release time.

synth.name: Amp Attack
synth.description: Amplitude envelope attack time.

synth.name: Amp Decay
synth.description: Amplitude envelope decay time.

synth.name: Amp Sustain
synth.description: Amplitude envelope sustain level.

synth.name: Amp Release
synth.description: Amplitude envelope release time.

synth.name: Amp Velocity Amount
synth.description: How much note velocity scales loudness (0 = ignore velocity).

synth.name: LFO Waveform
synth.description: Shape of the global LFO. Duck drops at the start of every cycle and recovers (sidechain-style pumping; use it with LFO Tremolo Depth and LFO Sync).

synth.name: LFO Rate
synth.description: Rate of the global LFO (used while LFO Sync is Off).

synth.name: LFO Pitch Depth
synth.description: Constant vibrato depth (independent of the mod wheel).

synth.name: LFO Filter Depth
synth.description: Constant filter cutoff modulation depth.

synth.name: LFO Pulse Width Depth
synth.description: Pulse width modulation (PWM) depth for Pulse waveforms.

synth.name: LFO Tremolo Depth
synth.description: Amplitude modulation (tremolo) depth.

synth.name: Mod Wheel Vibrato Depth
synth.description: Extra vibrato depth at full mod wheel.

synth.name: Mod Wheel Filter LFO Depth
synth.description: Extra filter cutoff wobble depth at full mod wheel.

synth.name: Pitch Bend Range
synth.description: Pitch bend range in cents (tuning independent; 200 = +/-2 semitones).

synth.name: Max Voices
synth.description: Maximum polyphony (1 = mono).

synth.name: Glide Time
synth.description: Portamento time from the previously played note (0 = off).

synth.name: Unison Voices
synth.description: Stacked detuned copies of both oscillators per note (supersaw-style thickness). CPU grows with Max Voices x Unison Voices.

synth.name: Unison Detune
synth.description: Total detune spread across the unison copies.

synth.name: Unison Stereo Width
synth.description: How far the unison copies are spread left/right.

synth.name: Master Volume
synth.description: Output volume of the synth.

synth.name: Transpose
synth.description: Shifts incoming notes by this many MIDI note numbers (= semitones in 12-EDO, scale steps in other tunings). Applied at note-on, so automating it never cuts off or hangs sounding notes.

synth.name: Voice Mode
synth.description: Poly: chords. Mono: one note at a time (last note wins, returns to a still-held note), envelopes restart on every note. Legato: like Mono, but overlapping notes only change pitch (no envelope restart).

synth.name: Glide Mode
synth.description: Always: every note glides from the previous one. Legato only: glide only when the new note overlaps a held note.

synth.name: Unison Detune Curve
synth.description: Spacing of the unison copies: 0 = even, 1 = bunched near the centre pitch with a few far-out copies (supersaw-like).

synth.name: Unison Side Level
synth.description: Level of the outer unison copies relative to the centre one(s) (1 = all equal).

synth.name: LFO Sync
synth.description: Lock the LFO to the host tempo: one cycle per note value, phase locked to the beat grid (so it restarts on the beat). Off = free running at LFO Rate.

synth.name: Arp Mode
synth.description: Arpeggiator on the held notes, in time with the host tempo. Chord repeats the whole chord on every step (stabs; shape the rhythm with the Arp Step switches).

synth.name: Arp Rate
synth.description: Length of one arpeggiator step (note value, tempo synced).

synth.name: Arp Octave Range
synth.description: How many octaves (tuning periods) the arpeggio climbs.

synth.name: Arp Gate
synth.description: Note length as a fraction of the step (1 = notes touch; with Voice Mode Legato they slur).

synth.name: Arp Swing
synth.description: Share of each pair of steps given to the first one (50 = straight, 66.7 = triplet shuffle).

synth.name: Arp Pattern Length
synth.description: Length of the step on/off pattern (Arp Step 1..16). The pattern restarts every this many steps, counted from beat 0 of the host.

synth.name: Arp Step 1
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 1 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 2
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 2 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 3
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 3 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 4
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 4 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 5
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 5 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 6
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 6 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 7
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 7 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 8
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 8 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 9
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 9 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 10
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 10 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 11
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 11 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 12
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 12 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 13
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 13 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 14
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 14 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 15
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 15 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Arp Step 16
synth.description: Rhythm gate: whether arpeggiator step 16 plays (Off = rest).

synth.name: Noise Type
synth.description: White: hiss. Chip Long / Short: 8-bit console style shift-register noise, clocked from the note pitch (Short repeats every 93 steps: a pitched, metallic tone). Sample & Hold: random steps at the clock rate.

synth.name: Noise Clock
synth.description: Clock of the chip / S&H noise relative to the note (higher = brighter). At 0, Chip Short sounds at the note pitch.

synth.name: Noise Filter
synth.description: Extra filter on the noise only (before the main filter), e.g. a high-passed hiss or a band of noise.

synth.name: Noise Filter Cutoff
synth.description: Cutoff / centre frequency of the noise filter.

synth.name: Cutoff CC Number
synth.description: MIDI CC that moves the filter cutoff (74 = brightness; 0 = none). CC value 64 = no change.

synth.name: Cutoff CC Depth
synth.description: How far the cutoff CC moves the cutoff: CC 0 = this many octaves down, CC 127 = up.

synth.name: Tuning Source
synth.description: EDO sliders: Tuning Divisions / Period. Scale file: a Scala (.scl) scale saved as REAPER/Data/AmiSynth/tuning.txt (re-read on playback start or any slider change). Shared: the scale (and reference note / frequency) published by an "AmiSynth Tuning" JSFX on any track for the slot in Tuning Slot; changes there apply at once. Falls back to the EDO sliders when the file / slot is empty.

synth.name: Tuning Slot
synth.description: Which AmiSynth Tuning instance to follow when Tuning Source is Shared (its Slot number), so one song can use several scales.

synth.name: Chorus
synth.description: Stereo chorus on the whole synth (first effect). Off = bypassed, no CPU.

synth.name: Chorus Mix
synth.description: Dry/wet balance of the chorus (0 = dry, 0.5 = classic chorus, 1 = only the modulated copy: vibrato).

synth.name: Chorus Rate
synth.description: Speed of the chorus sweep (left and right a quarter cycle apart).

synth.name: Chorus Depth
synth.description: How far the delay sweeps (from 7 ms up to 7 ms + depth). More = more detune and wobble.

synth.name: Delay
synth.description: Stereo echo after the chorus. Off = bypassed, no CPU.

synth.name: Delay Mix
synth.description: Dry/wet balance of the delay (0 = dry, 1 = only the echoes).

synth.name: Delay Sync
synth.description: Echo time as a note value at the host tempo (JSFX: REAPER tempo, web: BPM). Off = use Delay Time. Capped at 4 s.

synth.name: Delay Time
synth.description: Echo time in ms when Delay Sync is Off. Changes glide (tape-like) instead of clicking.

synth.name: Delay Feedback
synth.description: How much of each echo is fed back (more = more repeats).

synth.name: Delay Ping-Pong
synth.description: On: the echoes bounce left -> right -> left (input summed to mono). Off: each side echoes itself.

synth.name: Delay High Cut
synth.description: Low-pass in the feedback loop: every repeat gets darker (damping, like tape or analog delays).

synth.name: Reverb
synth.description: Algorithmic reverb (diffusers + 4-line feedback delay network) after the delay. Off = bypassed, no CPU.

synth.name: Reverb Mix
synth.description: Dry/wet balance of the reverb (0 = dry, 1 = only the reverb).

synth.name: Reverb Decay
synth.description: Reverb time: how long the tail takes to fall by 60 dB.

synth.name: Reverb Size
synth.description: Size of the space (spacing of the reflections): 0 = small room, 1 = large hall.

synth.name: Reverb Damping
synth.description: How fast high frequencies die in the tail (0 = bright, 1 = dark).

synth.name: Osc1 Wavetable
synth.description: Wavetable bank of oscillator 1 (used while Osc1 Waveform is Wavetable). Basic Shapes: sine -> triangle -> saw -> square. PWM Sweep: pulse 50 % -> 5 %. Vocal Formants: vowels a-e-i-o-u. Harmonic Sweep: a band of harmonics rising 5 octaves. Digital: 8-bit XOR waveforms. Band-limited, generated in the synth (no samples).

synth.name: Osc1 WT Position
synth.description: Position in the oscillator 1 wavetable (0 = first frame, 1 = last; frames are crossfaded in between).

synth.name: Osc2 Wavetable
synth.description: Wavetable bank of oscillator 2 (used while Osc2 Waveform is Wavetable). Same banks as Osc1 Wavetable.

synth.name: Osc2 WT Position
synth.description: Position in the oscillator 2 wavetable (0 = first frame, 1 = last).

synth.name: WT Position LFO
synth.description: How far the global LFO moves the wavetable position of both oscillators (+/- this amount at the LFO peaks; the result is limited to 0..1).

synth.name: WT Position Filter Env
synth.description: How far the filter envelope moves the wavetable position of both oscillators (negative = moves it down).

synth.name: WT Position Amp Env
synth.description: How far the amp envelope moves the wavetable position of both oscillators (negative = moves it down).

synth.name: LFO2 Waveform
synth.description: Shape of the second global LFO. It only acts through the mod matrix (source LFO 2).

synth.name: LFO2 Rate
synth.description: Rate of LFO 2 (used while LFO2 Sync is Off).

synth.name: LFO2 Sync
synth.description: Lock LFO 2 to the host tempo (one cycle per note value, phase locked to the beat grid). Off = free running at LFO2 Rate.

synth.name: Mod Env Attack
synth.description: Attack time of the per-note modulation envelope (mod matrix source Mod Env).

synth.name: Mod Env Decay
synth.description: Decay time of the modulation envelope.

synth.name: Mod Env Sustain
synth.description: Sustain level of the modulation envelope.

synth.name: Mod Env Release
synth.description: Release time of the modulation envelope.

synth.name: Mod 1 Source
synth.description: Mod matrix slot 1: what modulates. LFO 1 / LFO 2 / Random (a new value per note) swing -1..1; Mod Env, Velocity, Mod Wheel (CC1) and Pressure (channel pressure or polyphonic aftertouch) go 0..1; Key Track is the octaves above (+) / below (-) middle C. Off = slot unused.

synth.name: Mod 1 Destination
synth.description: Mod matrix slot 1: what is modulated (per note, except LFO 1 / LFO 2 Rate which are global and only follow LFO 1, LFO 2, Mod Wheel and channel pressure). Off = slot unused.

synth.name: Mod 1 Amount
synth.description: Mod matrix slot 1: how far the destination moves at source value 1, in the destination's unit: Pitch / Osc2 Pitch in cents, Filter Cutoff / LFO Rate in octaves, FM Index in rad, Amp in dB, Resonance / Pulse Width / Noise Level added to the knob value (0..1), Pan -1 (left) .. +1 (right). Negative values invert.

synth.name: Mod 2 Source
synth.description: Mod matrix slot 2: what modulates. LFO 1 / LFO 2 / Random (a new value per note) swing -1..1; Mod Env, Velocity, Mod Wheel (CC1) and Pressure (channel pressure or polyphonic aftertouch) go 0..1; Key Track is the octaves above (+) / below (-) middle C. Off = slot unused.

synth.name: Mod 2 Destination
synth.description: Mod matrix slot 2: what is modulated (per note, except LFO 1 / LFO 2 Rate which are global and only follow LFO 1, LFO 2, Mod Wheel and channel pressure). Off = slot unused.

synth.name: Mod 2 Amount
synth.description: Mod matrix slot 2: how far the destination moves at source value 1, in the destination's unit: Pitch / Osc2 Pitch in cents, Filter Cutoff / LFO Rate in octaves, FM Index in rad, Amp in dB, Resonance / Pulse Width / Noise Level added to the knob value (0..1), Pan -1 (left) .. +1 (right). Negative values invert.

synth.name: Mod 3 Source
synth.description: Mod matrix slot 3: what modulates. LFO 1 / LFO 2 / Random (a new value per note) swing -1..1; Mod Env, Velocity, Mod Wheel (CC1) and Pressure (channel pressure or polyphonic aftertouch) go 0..1; Key Track is the octaves above (+) / below (-) middle C. Off = slot unused.

synth.name: Mod 3 Destination
synth.description: Mod matrix slot 3: what is modulated (per note, except LFO 1 / LFO 2 Rate which are global and only follow LFO 1, LFO 2, Mod Wheel and channel pressure). Off = slot unused.

synth.name: Mod 3 Amount
synth.description: Mod matrix slot 3: how far the destination moves at source value 1, in the destination's unit: Pitch / Osc2 Pitch in cents, Filter Cutoff / LFO Rate in octaves, FM Index in rad, Amp in dB, Resonance / Pulse Width / Noise Level added to the knob value (0..1), Pan -1 (left) .. +1 (right). Negative values invert.

synth.name: Mod 4 Source
synth.description: Mod matrix slot 4: what modulates. LFO 1 / LFO 2 / Random (a new value per note) swing -1..1; Mod Env, Velocity, Mod Wheel (CC1) and Pressure (channel pressure or polyphonic aftertouch) go 0..1; Key Track is the octaves above (+) / below (-) middle C. Off = slot unused.

synth.name: Mod 4 Destination
synth.description: Mod matrix slot 4: what is modulated (per note, except LFO 1 / LFO 2 Rate which are global and only follow LFO 1, LFO 2, Mod Wheel and channel pressure). Off = slot unused.

synth.name: Mod 4 Amount
synth.description: Mod matrix slot 4: how far the destination moves at source value 1, in the destination's unit: Pitch / Osc2 Pitch in cents, Filter Cutoff / LFO Rate in octaves, FM Index in rad, Amp in dB, Resonance / Pulse Width / Noise Level added to the knob value (0..1), Pan -1 (left) .. +1 (right). Negative values invert.

phys.name: Tuning Divisions Per Period
phys.description: Equal divisions of the period (12 = standard 12-TET, 19/22/31/53 etc. for microtonal EDOs). Ignored while a custom scale table is loaded.

phys.name: Tuning Period
phys.description: Size of the repeating period. 1200 = octave, 1901.955 = tritave (Bohlen-Pierce).

phys.name: Tuning Reference Note
phys.description: MIDI note number that sounds at the reference frequency.

phys.name: Tuning Reference Frequency
phys.description: Frequency of the reference note.

phys.name: Physical Model
phys.description: String: plucked delay-line loop. Modal: tuned resonators struck by a mallet. Bowed: delay lines + bow friction. Wind: bore + reed/jet. Mesh: 2D wave equation on a grid. Stiff string: string with dispersion (inharmonic partials). Brass: bore + buzzing lips.

phys.name: String Excitation
phys.description: What initially fills the delay line: a burst of noise (plucked) or a smooth pulse (hammered).

phys.name: String Decay
phys.description: Time for the fundamental to fall by 60 dB while the key is held (loop gain per round trip).

phys.name: String Damping
phys.description: Low-pass in the loop: higher = high harmonics die out faster (nylon/felt-like).

phys.name: String Pick Position
phys.description: Where the string is plucked (0.5 = middle, removes even harmonics; near 0 = bright/thin).

phys.name: String Pick Brightness
phys.description: Spectrum of the excitation (soft finger vs hard pick).

phys.name: Modal Material
phys.description: Set of mode frequency ratios / gains (measured or textbook values for each object).

phys.name: Modal Decay
phys.description: Decay time (-60 dB) of the lowest mode.

phys.name: Modal High Mode Damping
phys.description: How much faster higher modes decay than the fundamental.

phys.name: Modal Mallet Hardness
phys.description: Short hard mallet (1) excites high modes; long soft mallet (0) mostly the low ones.

phys.name: Modal Strike Position
phys.description: Where the object is struck; modes with a node there are not excited (approximation: sin(pi*k*pos)).

phys.name: Modal Ratio Stretch
phys.description: Bends the mode ratios toward (negative) or away from (positive) harmonic, to hear what inharmonicity does.

phys.name: Bow Pressure
phys.description: Force of the bow on the string: low = airy/flautando, high = gritty (steeper friction curve).

phys.name: Bow Speed
phys.description: Bow velocity (loudness and brightness of the Helmholtz motion).

phys.name: Bow Position
phys.description: Distance of the bow from the bridge (small = sul ponticello, larger = sul tasto).

phys.name: Bow Attack
phys.description: Time for the bow to reach full speed.

phys.name: Bowed String Brightness
phys.description: Losses of high frequencies at the bridge (string material / damping).

phys.name: Wind Type
phys.description: Clarinet: a reed valve at the closed end of a cylindrical bore (odd harmonics). Flute: an air jet across an open bore. Saxophone / Oboe: a reed on a conical bore (all harmonics); the double reed sits further down a narrower cone, for a thinner, nasal tone.

phys.name: Breath Pressure
phys.description: Blowing pressure; too low does not start the tone, too high overblows.

phys.name: Breath Noise
phys.description: Turbulence noise mixed into the breath.

phys.name: Breath Attack
phys.description: Time for the breath pressure to build up.

phys.name: Embouchure
phys.description: Reed stiffness (clarinet) or the air jet offset against the edge (flute: more even harmonics).

phys.name: Mesh Shape
phys.description: Shape of the vibrating 2D surface (fixed edges).

phys.name: Mesh Resolution
phys.description: Grid points per side (more = more modes and a smoother sound, but more CPU). Max 3 voices in this model.

phys.name: Mesh Decay
phys.description: Overall decay time of the surface.

phys.name: Mesh High Damping
phys.description: Extra damping of short wavelengths (high modes die faster, like a skin).

phys.name: Mesh Strike X
phys.description: Horizontal strike position (0.5 = centre).

phys.name: Mesh Strike Y
phys.description: Vertical strike position (0.5 = centre). Hitting the centre excites mostly the symmetric modes.

phys.name: Mesh Mallet Hardness
phys.description: Small hard mallet (1) vs broad soft mallet (0).

phys.name: Piano Inharmonicity
phys.description: String stiffness: higher partials are pushed sharp (dispersion all-passes in the loop, set per note from a piano-like B curve). 0.35 = typical piano, 1 = about 8x.

phys.name: Piano Hammer Hardness
phys.description: Felt stiffness of the hammer. The felt hardens as it is compressed, so louder notes are always brighter; this sets the overall brightness.

phys.name: Piano Strike Position
phys.description: Where the hammer hits (about 1/8 on real pianos).

phys.name: Piano Decay
phys.description: Decay time of the fundamental while the key is held.

phys.name: Piano Damping
phys.description: Extra loss of high partials per round trip.

phys.name: Piano Soundboard
phys.description: How much of the sound comes through the soundboard (16 resonances fed by the bridge) instead of straight from the strings.

phys.name: Piano Unison Detune
phys.description: Two strings per note slightly detuned: slow beating and a two-stage decay.

phys.name: Vibrato Depth
phys.description: Pitch vibrato for the delay-line models (string, bowed, wind, stiff string).

phys.name: Vibrato Rate
phys.description: Vibrato speed.

phys.name: Release Damping
phys.description: Decay time after the key is released (like a damper touching the string/bar).

phys.name: Velocity Amount
phys.description: How much velocity changes loudness and brightness.

phys.name: Stereo Width
phys.description: Spreads low notes left and high notes right.

phys.name: Pitch Bend Range
phys.description: Pitch bend range in cents.

phys.name: Room
phys.description: Amount of a small room (4-line feedback delay network). Acoustic instruments sound dry and synthetic without one.

phys.name: Room Decay
phys.description: Reverberation time (T60) of the room.

phys.name: Volume
phys.description: Output volume of the physical model instrument.

phys.name: Brass Blowing Pressure
phys.description: Mouth pressure: louder and brighter (brass get brassier the harder they are blown). Velocity adds to it.

phys.name: Brass Lip Buzz
phys.description: How easily the lips open: more = a buzzier, edgier tone.

phys.name: Brass Attack
phys.description: How fast the pressure builds up (short = a tongued attack).

phys.name: Brass Bell Brightness
phys.description: Low-pass of the sound leaving the bell; low values sound like a mute or a horn played into the hand.

phys.name: Tuning Source
phys.description: EDO sliders: Tuning Divisions / Period. Scale file: a Scala (.scl) scale saved as REAPER/Data/AmiSynth/tuning.txt (re-read on playback start or any slider change). Shared: the scale (and reference note / frequency) published by an "AmiSynth Tuning" JSFX on any track for the slot in Tuning Slot; changes there apply at once. Falls back to the EDO sliders when the file / slot is empty.

phys.name: Amp
phys.description: Guitar amp after the instrument (before the room): pre EQ, drive and a speaker cabinet filter. Clean adds only colour; Crunch to Distortion clip harder (Distortion has two gain stages). Mostly for the String model (electric guitar).

phys.name: Amp Gain
phys.description: Drive into the amp (range depends on the amp type).

phys.name: Amp Tone
phys.description: Brightness of the speaker cabinet (its high-frequency roll-off).

phys.name: Amp Level
phys.description: Output level of the amp.

phys.name: Tuning Slot
phys.description: Which AmiSynth Tuning instance to follow when Tuning Source is Shared (its Slot number), so one song can use several scales.

phys.name: Sustain Pedal
phys.description: MIDI CC64 delays note-off damping until pedal release. Auto supports plucked strings, piano and modal materials except Drum Membrane; bowed, wind, brass and mesh ignore it. On sustains all models. Natural decay still continues.

phys.name: Pressure to Breath / Bow
phys.description: How much aftertouch (channel pressure or polyphonic aftertouch, 0..1) adds to Breath Pressure (wind), Brass Blowing Pressure (brass) and Bow Pressure (bowed) while a note sounds. 0 = off.

phys.name: Pressure to Vibrato
phys.description: Extra vibrato depth at full aftertouch, per note (delay-line models: string, bowed, wind, stiff string, brass). 0 = off.

phys.name: Pressure to Brightness
phys.description: How much aftertouch adds to Bowed String Brightness (bowed) and Brass Bell Brightness (brass). 0 = off.

drums.name: Kick Pitch
drums.description: Final (resting) frequency of the kick sine.

drums.name: Kick Decay
drums.description: Amplitude decay time of the kick (to -60 dB).

drums.name: Kick Tone
drums.description: Click transient and saturation amount.

drums.name: Kick Level
drums.description: Output level of the kick.

drums.name: Kick Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the kick (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Kick Pitch Sweep Depth
drums.description: How many octaves above the resting pitch the kick starts.

drums.name: Kick Pitch Sweep Time
drums.description: Time constant of the downward pitch sweep.

drums.name: Snare Pitch
drums.description: Frequency of the tonal (drum shell) component.

drums.name: Snare Decay
drums.description: Decay time of the noise (snares) component.

drums.name: Snare Tone
drums.description: Brightness of the band-passed noise (low = dark, high = bright).

drums.name: Snare Level
drums.description: Output level of the snare.

drums.name: Snare Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the snare (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Snare Snappy
drums.description: Balance between tonal body (0) and noise (1).

drums.name: Clap Pitch
drums.description: Center frequency of the band-pass filter on the noise.

drums.name: Clap Decay
drums.description: Decay time of the reverberant tail after the bursts.

drums.name: Clap Tone
drums.description: Filter sharpness (low = wide/noisy, high = narrow/ringing).

drums.name: Clap Level
drums.description: Output level of the clap.

drums.name: Clap Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the clap (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Clap Burst Spread
drums.description: Gap between the individual hand-clap bursts.

drums.name: Closed Hi-Hat Pitch
drums.description: Base frequency of the metallic square-wave cluster.

drums.name: Closed Hi-Hat Decay
drums.description: Decay time of the closed hi-hat.

drums.name: Closed Hi-Hat Tone
drums.description: High-pass cutoff (brightness).

drums.name: Closed Hi-Hat Level
drums.description: Output level of the closed hi-hat.

drums.name: Closed Hi-Hat Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the closed hi-hat (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Closed Hi-Hat Metal Mix
drums.description: Balance between noise (0) and detuned square cluster (1).

drums.name: Open Hi-Hat Pitch
drums.description: Base frequency of the metallic square-wave cluster.

drums.name: Open Hi-Hat Decay
drums.description: Decay time of the open hi-hat (closed hi-hat chokes it).

drums.name: Open Hi-Hat Tone
drums.description: High-pass cutoff (brightness).

drums.name: Open Hi-Hat Level
drums.description: Output level of the open hi-hat.

drums.name: Open Hi-Hat Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the open hi-hat (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Open Hi-Hat Metal Mix
drums.description: Balance between noise (0) and detuned square cluster (1).

drums.name: Low Tom Pitch
drums.description: Resting frequency of the tom sine.

drums.name: Low Tom Decay
drums.description: Amplitude decay time of the tom.

drums.name: Low Tom Tone
drums.description: Downward pitch bend at the attack plus stick noise.

drums.name: Low Tom Level
drums.description: Output level of the low tom.

drums.name: Low Tom Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the low tom (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Mid Tom Pitch
drums.description: Resting frequency of the tom sine.

drums.name: Mid Tom Decay
drums.description: Amplitude decay time of the tom.

drums.name: Mid Tom Tone
drums.description: Downward pitch bend at the attack plus stick noise.

drums.name: Mid Tom Level
drums.description: Output level of the mid tom.

drums.name: Mid Tom Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the mid tom (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: High Tom Pitch
drums.description: Resting frequency of the tom sine.

drums.name: High Tom Decay
drums.description: Amplitude decay time of the tom.

drums.name: High Tom Tone
drums.description: Downward pitch bend at the attack plus stick noise.

drums.name: High Tom Level
drums.description: Output level of the high tom.

drums.name: High Tom Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the high tom (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Rimshot Pitch
drums.description: Frequency of the high resonance (a lower partial follows at ~0.27x).

drums.name: Rimshot Decay
drums.description: Decay time of the rim click.

drums.name: Rimshot Tone
drums.description: Drive / hardness of the click.

drums.name: Rimshot Level
drums.description: Output level of the rimshot.

drums.name: Rimshot Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the rimshot (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Cowbell Pitch
drums.description: Frequency of the lower square (the upper one sits at ~1.48x, as on the 808).

drums.name: Cowbell Decay
drums.description: Decay time of the cowbell tail.

drums.name: Cowbell Tone
drums.description: Band-pass brightness.

drums.name: Cowbell Level
drums.description: Output level of the cowbell.

drums.name: Cowbell Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the cowbell (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Crash Pitch
drums.description: Base frequency of the metallic square-wave cluster.

drums.name: Crash Decay
drums.description: Decay time of the crash cymbal.

drums.name: Crash Tone
drums.description: High-pass cutoff (brightness).

drums.name: Crash Level
drums.description: Output level of the crash.

drums.name: Crash Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the crash (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Crash Metal Mix
drums.description: Balance between noise (0) and detuned square cluster (1).

drums.name: Ride Pitch
drums.description: Base frequency of the metallic square-wave cluster.

drums.name: Ride Decay
drums.description: Decay time of the ride cymbal.

drums.name: Ride Tone
drums.description: High-pass cutoff (brightness).

drums.name: Ride Level
drums.description: Output level of the ride.

drums.name: Ride Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the ride (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Ride Metal Mix
drums.description: Balance between noise (0) and detuned square cluster (1).

drums.name: Shaker Pitch
drums.description: Centre frequency of the band-passed noise.

drums.name: Shaker Decay
drums.description: Decay time after the swell.

drums.name: Shaker Tone
drums.description: Attack swell length (0 = instant, 1 = slow shake).

drums.name: Shaker Level
drums.description: Output level of the shaker.

drums.name: Shaker Pan
drums.description: Stereo position of the shaker (-1 = left, +1 = right).

drums.name: Drum Master Volume
drums.description: Output volume of the drum machine.

drums.name: Kick Out In Main Mix
drums.description: Whether the kick also play in the main mix (outputs 1/2). In the JSFX they always play on their own outputs 3/4.

drums.name: Snare/Clap Out In Main Mix
drums.description: Whether the snare, clap and rimshot also play in the main mix (outputs 1/2). In the JSFX they always play on their own outputs 5/6.

drums.name: Hats/Cymbals Out In Main Mix
drums.description: Whether the hi-hats, crash and ride also play in the main mix (outputs 1/2). In the JSFX they always play on their own outputs 7/8.

drums.name: Toms/Perc Out In Main Mix
drums.description: Whether the toms, cowbell and shaker also play in the main mix (outputs 1/2). In the JSFX they always play on their own outputs 9/10.

tuning.name: Slot
tuning.description: Slot this scale is published to. Instruments with Tuning Source = Shared and the same Tuning Slot follow it.

tuning.name: Scale Source
tuning.description: Sliders: Scale Size + Degree 1..N below. File: the Scala file chosen in Scale File (falls back to the sliders if it cannot be read).

tuning.name: Scale File
tuning.description: A Scala (.scl) scale saved with a .txt name in REAPER/Data/AmiSynth/ (the value is its position in that folder, alphabetical).

tuning.name: Reference Note
tuning.description: MIDI note that sounds at the reference frequency (replaces the instruments' own reference while they follow this slot).

tuning.name: Reference Frequency
tuning.description: Frequency of the reference note.

tuning.name: Scale Size
tuning.description: Notes per period (Degree 1..this; the last one is the period, e.g. 1200 cents for an octave).

tuning.name: Degree 1
tuning.description: Pitch of scale degree 1 above the reference, in cents (Scala order: degree 0 = 0 cents is implied; degree Scale Size = the period).
